svg.title: KQML-Liver end-to-end pipeline: input, feature engineering, KAN, quantum circuit, output
svg.desc: Animated overview: 10 ILPD clinical features are preprocessed and augmented, compressed by a KAN, processed by a shallow QAOA-inspired quantum circuit and classified by a sigmoid layer.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
